summary: Handle all IPP faults and execute printer repairs without a shell

delivery.outcome: IPP printer-state-reasons tokens are evaluated independently, and `fixos printers --fix` executes validated argv repair steps with `shell=False` across Linux, macOS, and Windows (closing #183).
nonGoals: No modification to tests/twin/printers/** (handled separately in ticket-146).

architecture.decision: Introduce `fixos/plugins/builtin/printer_repairs.py` with strict queue-name and IP-address validation, building `list[list[str]]` argv steps executed via `subprocess.run(..., shell=False)` (using `-EncodedCommand` UTF-16LE on Windows); attach structured `repair` metadata to `Finding.data` while retaining human-readable `Finding.command`.

validation.evidence: unit tests for mixed-order IPP printer-state-reasons
unit tests for shell=False repair argv generation and hostile input rejection

commands: python -m ruff check fixos/plugins/builtin/printer_repairs.py fixos/plugins/builtin/printers.py fixos/cli/printers_cmd.py tests/unit/test_printer_repairs.py tests/unit/test_printers_plugin.py
